children: Banco Santander S.A. Sponsored ADR (BME:SAN) has been active across capital moves and deals: sizable buybacks repurchased ~18.2% of 2021 shares, a Court of Appeal trimmed a £677M AXA payout, a $25 redemption of Series I preferred is set for Oct 15, and SAN led underwriting and a £1.1bn loan for acquisitions.
Banco Santander S.A. Sponsored ADR Buyback Update
: Banco Santander (SAN) bought back €558.9M of shares from Sept 10–16, 2026, about 30.6% of its buyback cap; repurchased ~18.2% of outstanding shares as of 2021
Court Of Appeal Overturns AXA Payout
: Court of Appeal ruled for Banco Santander S.A. Sponsored ADR (SAN), overturning a £677M payout to AXA: indemnity covers acts after Dec 1, 2000, not pre‑Dec 1 policies.
Santander Holdings USA Redeem Perpetual Shares
: Banco Santander (SAN) will see Santander Holdings USA redeem all Series I perpetual preferred depositary shares (5.4M) on Oct 15, 2026 at $25.00; dividend paid Oct 15 to record holders Sept 30.
SAN Co-Lead Arranger For Drax Solar Loan
: Banco Santander (SAN) co-led a £1.1bn loan, acting as lead arranger/lender with JPMorgan to fund Drax Solar acquisition — loan size £1.1bn; SAN identified as lead arranger/lender.
: Banco Santander (SAN) served as an underwriter on privately priced Jupiter loans at roughly $0.89–$0.91 per dollar; Jefferies also underwrote the deal. No public comment reported.
